description: The pie chart represents the distribution of various emotions, comparing their relative proportions. The chart is divided into six slices, each representing a distinct emotion. The slices are labeled as Frustration (light blue, 25.1%), Neutral (dark blue, 23.1%), Anger (yellow, 14.9%), Sadness (brown, 14.7%), Happiness (red, 14.1%), and another slice labeled Happiness is actually the sixth category (8.1%, no distinct color mentioned but distinguishable). The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices are arranged in a clockwise order, with the largest slice (Frustration) positioned at the top left and the smallest (Happiness, 8.1%) at the top right. A legend is partially visible, represented by a gray rectangle, but it is not fully shown. The slices are not visually emphasized or exploded. The segments appear to be ordered in descending size, with the largest slice first.
